description: Cross-FEAT integration verification and fixes. After FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 are implemented, run full sync flow on real device/emulator, verify employee data appears in UI, test multiple login scenarios (admin, SS employees, AO employees), and confirm Firestore has correct data. Fix any integration issues found.
steps: Build app with both FEAT-001 (rules) and FEAT-002 (code) changes
Uninstall app completely to ensure fresh database
Test Scenario 1 - Admin first login: Login as admin@workcore.com, verify logcat shows 'Fetched X employees' (X >= 73), verify UI shows AdminDashboardScreen with employee data
Test Scenario 2 - SS employee login: Login as SS001 (ML Team), verify sync fetches employees, verify roster shows ML Team members only
Test Scenario 3 - AO employee login: Login as AO001 (Marketing), verify sync fetches employees, verify roster shows Marketing Team members only
Verify Firestore data: Open Firebase Console > Firestore > employees collection, confirm 73+ documents with correct fields (name, email, team, teamId, companyId, role, isActive)
Verify no errors in Firestore console > Firestore > Rules > Rules Playground or security issues tab
Run Android tests if available: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest (verify no sync logic breaks)
Spot check: Query Firestore for admin user, confirm role='ADMIN', query for SS001, confirm team='ML Team' and teamId='TEAM_ML'
acceptance_criteria: First fresh login uploads employees to Firestore and fetches them back (all 73+)
Admin dashboard displays employee list from synced data (not just seed data)
Employee team rosters filter correctly by team (SS001 sees only ML Team, AO001 sees only Marketing)
Firestore console shows correct employee documents with all required fields
No PERMISSION_DENIED or other security errors in Firestore logs during sync
Logs at each step match expected format (prefixed with emoji, clear descriptions)
Unit tests pass (if any existing tests cover sync flow)
verification: Run app on emulator or real device: ./gradlew installDebug && adb logcat | grep -E '(Fetched|Uploaded|sync)' (watch logs during login)
Verify AdminDashboardScreen displays employee count > 0 after sync completes
Navigate to Roster/Analytics screens, confirm team members displayed (not empty)
Open Firebase Console, search employees collection for 'SS001', verify document exists with correct fields
Test on multiple devices or emulator snapshots to verify sync works consistently
Logout and login again with different role (admin → employee), verify sync still works
If possible, test with network offline then online: app should queue sync and retry when network returns
findings: FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 are code-complete but integration depends on both being deployed: FEAT-001 fixes rules, FEAT-002 implements upload + validation. This step verifies they work together and catches any mismatches in field names, logic, or assumptions.
